# Jeu du petit compagnon

A virtual pet game in French: Rumi, the very fluffy white wizard cat, plays outside in a colourful garden with his witch friend. Wash him, feed him, give him water and put him to sleep before his need bars run out (5 minutes) to earn coins. Neglect Rumi and you lose coins, and when the "not happy" bar fills up, you lose all your coins.
